# Newsweek

> > Newsweek is a leading global news magazine and digital media platform covering breaking news, politics, business, culture, and special events.

Beyond its editorial content, Newsweek offers premium digital advertising solutions including Homepage Takeovers (HPTO), native advertising, and video pre-roll placements. The organization also hosts marquee events such as Climate Week NYC conferences focused on sustainability and the green transition.

## Key Topics

- Homepage Takeover (HPTO)
- First Impression Takeover (FITO)
- Native Advertising
- Video Pre-Roll
- Interscroller
- Digital Advertising Solutions
- Brand Awareness Campaigns
- Climate Week NYC
- Green Transition
- Sustainability Conference
- Decarbonization
- Energy Storage
- ESG Reporting
- Programmatic Advertising
- Display Ads

## Digital Advertising Solutions

- [Digital Solutions](https://advertising.newsweek.com/digital-solutions): Newsweek's digital advertising solutions including HPTO and native ads

## Events & Conferences

- [Pillars of the Green Transition 2025](https://events.newsweek.com/climateweek25): Climate Week NYC 2025 event at One World Trade Center on sustainability
